# Generated by vdeps.py --generate-cmake
# Do not edit manually
# Consume this file from a parent project with add_subdirectory(vdeps).
# Generated targets always run vdeps.py --build --auto-skip.
# Run vdeps.py manually if you need a forced rebuild or troubleshooting.

cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20)
project(vdeps NONE)

find_package(Python3 REQUIRED COMPONENTS Interpreter)

option(VDEPS_USE_LLVM "Use Clang/LLVM compiler on Windows" OFF)
option(VDEPS_STATIC_RUNTIME "Build with static MSVC runtime (/MT, /MTd)" OFF)
option(VDEPS_DYNAMIC_RUNTIME "Build with dynamic MSVC runtime (/MD, /MDd)" OFF)
set(VDEPS_SANITIZE "" CACHE STRING "Sanitizer set passed to vdeps.py --sanitize (e.g. thread,address,memory,undefined). Empty disables.")
set(VDEPS_PARALLEL "" CACHE STRING "Cap parallel build workers (forwarded as --parallel N). Empty uses all cores.")
set(VDEPS_ARCH "" CACHE STRING "Target architecture on macOS passed to vdeps.py --arch (arm64 or x64; x86_64/amd64 aliases accepted). Empty uses host arch.")

# Default to static if neither runtime is specified
if(NOT VDEPS_STATIC_RUNTIME AND NOT VDEPS_DYNAMIC_RUNTIME)
    set(VDEPS_STATIC_RUNTIME ON)
endif()

# Build a sanitizer suffix tag from VDEPS_SANITIZE so target + dir
string(REPLACE "," ";" _VDEPS_SANITIZE_LIST "${VDEPS_SANITIZE}")
set(_VDEPS_SANITIZE_TAG "")
foreach(_part IN LISTS _VDEPS_SANITIZE_LIST)
    string(STRIP "${_part}" _part)
    if(_part)
        if(_VDEPS_SANITIZE_TAG)
            set(_VDEPS_SANITIZE_TAG "${_VDEPS_SANITIZE_TAG}_${_part}")
        else()
            set(_VDEPS_SANITIZE_TAG "${_part}")
        endif()
    endif()
endforeach()

# Helper macro for building a single dependency
macro(vdeps_build_dep TARGET_NAME DEP_NAME TARGET_SUFFIX EXTRA_ARGS)
    separate_arguments(_VDEPS_EXTRA_ARGS NATIVE_COMMAND "${EXTRA_ARGS}")
    add_custom_target(${TARGET_NAME}_${TARGET_SUFFIX}
        COMMAND ${Python3_EXECUTABLE} "${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/../vdeps.py"
                --build --auto-skip ${_VDEPS_EXTRA_ARGS} "${DEP_NAME}"
        WORKING_DIRECTORY "${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/.."
        USES_TERMINAL
        COMMENT "Building vdeps dependency: ${DEP_NAME} (${TARGET_SUFFIX})"
    )
endmacro()

# Static runtime variants (/MT)
set(_VDEPS_EXTRA_ARGV "")
if(VDEPS_PARALLEL)
    set(_VDEPS_EXTRA_ARGV "${_VDEPS_EXTRA_ARGV} --parallel ${VDEPS_PARALLEL}")
endif()
if(VDEPS_ARCH)
    set(_VDEPS_EXTRA_ARGV "${_VDEPS_EXTRA_ARGV} --arch ${VDEPS_ARCH}")
endif()
if(VDEPS_STATIC_RUNTIME)
    vdeps_build_dep(vdeps_nvrhi nvrhi mt "${_VDEPS_EXTRA_ARGV}")
    vdeps_build_dep(vdeps_shadermake ShaderMake mt "${_VDEPS_EXTRA_ARGV}")
    vdeps_build_dep(vdeps_vk_bootstrap vk-bootstrap mt "${_VDEPS_EXTRA_ARGV}")
    add_custom_target(vdeps_all_mt)
    add_dependencies(vdeps_all_mt vdeps_nvrhi_mt vdeps_shadermake_mt vdeps_vk_bootstrap_mt)
endif()

endif()
if(VDEPS_ARCH)
    set(_VDEPS_EXTRA_ARGV "${_VDEPS_EXTRA_ARGV} --arch ${VDEPS_ARCH}")
endif()
if(VDEPS_STATIC_RUNTIME)
    if(VDEPS_USE_LLVM)
        vdeps_build_dep(vdeps_nvrhi nvrhi llvm_mt "${_VDEPS_EXTRA_ARGV}")
        vdeps_build_dep(vdeps_shadermake ShaderMake llvm_mt "${_VDEPS_EXTRA_ARGV}")

    endif()
endif()
